html: Two papers were accepted to EMNLP 2026: "MMGR: Multi-Modal Generative Reasoning" and "CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning".
Released "SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?", with the project page and code now available.
Joining UniPat AI as a Research Intern this summer, working on multimodal reasoning in agents.
Our paper "Breaking Down and Building Up: Mixture of Skill-Based Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents" (SkillNav) was accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference.
Added a new Blog section with SWE-Vision: A Minimal Agent for Advancing Visual Intelligence.
New preprint "MMGR: Multi-Modal Generative Reasoning" is now on arXiv.
Released preprint "Breaking Down and Building Up: Mixture of Skill-Based Vision-and-Language Navigation Agents" (SkillNav) on arXiv.
Start visiting at UCLA NLP Group, supervised by Prof. Kai-wei Chang.
One paper "Vision-and-Language Navigation with Analogical Textual Descriptions in LLMs" was accepted to EMNLP 2025 Main.
One paper "Cognitive Priming Prompting Facilitates Knowledge Elicitation in Multilingual Large Language Models" was accepted to ACL 2025 Findings.
One paper was accepted to CogSci 2025.
